attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) – Psychologist Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Classroom courses, seminars, conferences in blocks of at least 1 hour (unlimited); teaching/supervision max 10 h; clinical readings max 6 h; internet/distance courses with exam and certificate recognized by APA or a state/provincial psychological association max 18 h; peer consultation max 6 h
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours prorated by date of first licensure in the cycle.
rules.audit_note: Documentation submitted only if audited; keep records 2 years after the cycle ends.
rules.notes: Cycle starts Oct 1 of even years; renewal due Sept 30 of even years. Max 18 h online/self-study; at least 30 h in-person or live interactive webinar (DOPL page). Includes certified (provisional) prescribing psychologists.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-61-403; Utah Code 58-61-306

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same categories and limits as psychologists (R156-61-403(5))
rules.notes: Max 18 h online/self-study; at least 6 h in-person or live interactive webinar (DOPL page).
